description: What graphersal-serve's openapi.json gained after 0.8.0 (the 409 of a request the host marked read-only on every writing route, the 403/500 of the file root, the read-only notes of /api/info, /api/changes, /api/execute and /api/query), applied by graphersal-server over the 0.8.0 description it serves per database. Each operation replaces the engine's whole operation object; each response is added to components.responses. Drop an entry (and this file) once the pinned graphersal-serve carries it: a test refuses an entry the engine already has.

E409ReadOnlyRequest.description: A request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL): every route that writes is refused before anything runs, with `the graph is served read-only: writes are refused. This request has read access only: ask for write access to change the data.` (`READ_ONLY_HEADLINE`, `READ_ONLY_REQUEST_HELP`).

E409Write.description: Not possible in the server's state (no store, a read-only view, a conflict), or a request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL), refused before anything runs with `the graph is served read-only: writes are refused. This request has read access only: ask for write access to change the data.` (`READ_ONLY_HEADLINE`, `READ_ONLY_REQUEST_HELP`).

E403FileRoot.description: With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL): a `dir` that resolves outside it (a relative `dir` is resolved under the root; `..` and symbolic links are resolved): `'<dir>' is outside the server's file root: paths must lie inside the server's file root (a relative path is resolved under it)`. Without a `dir` the default directory next to the store is used, unchecked.

E500FileRoot.description: With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) that is not an existing directory (the host's configuration): `the server's file root is not an existing directory: ask the host's operator`.

GET /api/changes.description: `{version, commitSeq, recent: [{version, by, commitSeq, detail?}], view, mcp, damageFound, readOnly}` (`readOnly`: read-only now; it changes at run time with the host's runtime read-only toggle); `by` is the client of the commit (`X-Graphersal-Client` of a page, `mcp`, or `ai` with the conversation id in `detail`). Polled by the page to reload on changes it did not make. On a request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL) `readOnly` (and the `mcp` status's `readOnly`) is `true` for that request, while the graph stays writable for other requests.

readOnly.description: Writes are refused for this request: the server is read-only (`--read-only`, a Store the process may not write, the host's runtime read-only toggle on) or the host marked the request read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`).

GET /api/info.description: What the page needs to switch to this server: `protocol` (`graphersal/1` in every answer of every Graphersal host: the playground recognizes a host by it, never by `server`; a breaking change of this API bumps the number), `server` (the host's name: `graphersal-dev` for the CLI's dev server, `ContextBuilder::server_name`), `dev` (`true` for a development server such as the CLI's: the playground shows its DEV badge; `ContextBuilder::dev`), `version`, `saveable`, `source`, `presets` (the limits in force), `mcp` (`{endpoint, readOnly, client}` or null), `ai` (`{provider, model, readOnly, sendsDataTo, maxToolCallsPerTurn}` or null; never the key), `damageFound`, `embedders`, `readOnly` (`--read-only`, a Store the process may not write, or the host's runtime read-only toggle on (`ContextBuilder::runtime_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL; then modifying requests answer the one refusal `the graph is served read-only: writes are refused`, the writes that are no commit with 409): every write is refused), `uiProfile` (only when the host set one: `--ui-profile`, `ContextBuilder::ui_profile`; a built-in profile name or a profile object, EXPERIMENTAL), `adminRuns` (only when the host turned the run administration on: `{tokenRequired}`, EXPERIMENTAL; `--admin-runs`, `ContextBuilder::admin_runs`: `GET /api/admin/runs`, `POST /api/admin/runs/cancel`), `apiMode` (only in allow-list mode: `"allow-list"`, EXPERIMENTAL; `ContextBuilder::api_allow_list`: the server then answers only `GET /api/info`, `GET /api/changes` and `POST /api/query` for its selected saved queries, every other `/api/` endpoint and `/mcp` answer 403), `mountPath` (only when the host serves this graph under a URL prefix, `ContextBuilder::mount_path`, EXPERIMENTAL: the prefix such as `/db/acme`, no trailing `/`; then `openapi` is `<mountPath>/openapi.json` and `mcp.endpoint` `<mountPath>/mcp`; the host strips the prefix before the server routes, so every path of this description is relative to it). Answered without the session. On a request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL) `readOnly` (and the `mcp` status's `readOnly`) is `true` for that request, while the graph stays writable for other requests.

readOnly.description: Writes are refused for this request: the server is read-only (`--read-only`, a Store the process may not write, the host's runtime read-only toggle on) or the host marked the request read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`).

POST /api/admin/runs/cancel.summary: Run administration: kill a run by id (off by default)
POST /api/admin/runs/cancel.description: EXPERIMENTAL, off by default (see `GET /api/admin/runs`): cancels the run `id` whatever its client, an administrative act separate from a page's own `POST /api/cancel`. A run still waiting for the session runs nothing, a running one stops at its next check; both are rolled back. `{cancelled}`: whether such a run was registered (an ended run answers false).

parameters.name: X-Graphersal-Admin-Token
parameters.description: The run administration's token, when the host set one (`--admin-runs-token`, `ContextBuilder::admin_runs(Some(token))`; `GET /api/info` `adminRuns.tokenRequired`). Missing or wrong: 403.

403.description: The token is missing or wrong, or the server is in allow-list mode.

404.description: The run administration is off (the default): `the run administration is off: start the server with --admin-runs`.

POST /api/advise/apply.description: Recomputes the advice for `spec`, finds `id` and runs its catalog command (one commit): `{ok: true, id, kind, result}` or `{ok: false, error}`. With `ids` instead of `id`: applies every recommendation named in ONE commit (all new compression rules in one pass over the data), all or nothing: `{ok: true, applied: [{id, kind, title, memory_bytes}], memory_bytes}` or `{ok: false, error}`.

ids.description: Several recommendation ids, applied in one commit (instead of `id`).

spec.description: The advisor's thresholds; `{}`: the defaults, `everything: true`: every candidate.

POST /api/advise/dismiss.description: Hides it for `days` (without: for good); kept in the store's workload sidecar. `{ok}`.

POST /api/catalog/load.description: Stores a catalog file in one commit: `{loaded, graph}`. With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) a catalog with a job that writes outside the root is refused with 403 and nothing is loaded.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: true: drop the definitions the file does not have.

403.description: With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL): the catalog holds a job that writes outside the root (a stored job path must be absolute and inside the root); nothing is loaded: `nothing was loaded: job '<name>' writes '<path>' (<reason>); stored job paths must be absolute, and paths must lie inside the server's file root`.

POST /api/compression/drop-many.summary: Drop several compression rules in one commit
POST /api/compression/drop-many.description: `{dropped}`: how many; a name not stored is skipped.

POST /api/compression/recompress.description: The rule's entry after a new dictionary and re-encode (422 when there is none).

POST /api/element/create.description: Creates a vertex or an edge as ONE commit: `{ok: true, created, element, drawn}` or `{ok: false, errors}` (always 200).

POST /api/element/delete.description: Deletes a vertex with its edges, or an edge, as ONE commit: `{ok: true, deleted, edges}` or `{ok: false, errors}`.

POST /api/element/update.description: Writes the changed and removed top-level properties as ONE commit: `{ok: true, changed, element}` or `{ok: false, errors}` (always 200).

POST /api/execute.description: Runs a script (Gremlin in Rhai, `g.gql(..)` for GQL) as ONE unit (it commits when the answer is `ok`, and is rolled back otherwise). The answer is the playground's ExecuteResponse: `{ok, terminal, results | table | subgraph | text, execution: {error?, profile?}, mutated, changes, change_summary, ...}`; a failing script is reported in `execution.error` with status 200. On a request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL) it runs under the reading authorizer: a script that would write fails with a permission error and changes nothing. The failure is reported in `execution.error` with status 200.

runId.description: The page's own id of this run: `POST /api/cancel` with it cancels exactly this run.

POST /api/jobs/define.description: Defines or replaces a job of a user: `{ok: true, job}` or `{ok: false, errors}` (always 200). With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) a backup job's `path` is resolved under the root (a relative path is relative to the root; `..` and symbolic links are resolved) and the job stores the resolved path; a path that leaves the root is refused in `{ok: false, errors}` (still 200).

POST /api/jobs/enable.description: Switches a job on or off: its entry.

POST /api/jobs/run.description: Runs a job now and answers when it has finished: its entry (`last` = this run). Other requests are served meanwhile; 422 while the job or another job of its type runs.

POST /api/jobs/schedule.description: A system job's schedule (`null`: its built-in one): its entry.

POST /api/queries/define.description: `{ok: true, query}` or `{ok: false, errors}` (always 200); `replaces` renames in the same commit.

POST /api/query.description: One run of the saved query `name` with the named arguments `params` (an object; absent or null: none), as ONE unit like `POST /api/execute` but without the display: `{ok: true, results, mutated, changes}` (`results`: every result as JSON, never cut; `changes`: `{data, schema, definitions}`) or `{ok: false, error: {message, help?, ...}, mutated, changes}` with status 200 (an unknown query, a parameter its schema refuses, a write the authorizer denies). The server binds no parameter: the caller passes every one. The playground profile API's `query(name, params)` calls it. A full server runs any saved query under the playground's authorizer; a server in allow-list mode (`GET /api/info` `apiMode: "allow-list"`, EXPERIMENTAL) runs only the saved queries its host selected, under the host's access policy, and answers 403 `the saved query "<name>" is not offered by this server` for any other name (an unknown one included). On a request the host marked read-only (`Request::mark_read_only`, EXPERIMENTAL) it runs under the reading authorizer: a saved query that would write fails with a permission error and changes nothing. The failure is `{ok: false, error}` with status 200.

runId.description: The page's own id of this run: `POST /api/cancel` with it cancels exactly this run.

403.description: Allow-list mode: a saved query the server does not offer.

POST /api/save.description: Writes the graph back to its `--graph` file (and the schema to `--schema`): `{path, format, bytes, warnings, schemaPath?, warning?}`.

POST /api/schema/patch.description: Applies a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) to the stored schema.

POST /api/schema/set.description: Stores the schema, validated against the data (422 with the violations).

POST /api/store/attic/fork.description: Copies an attic entry into a new store `dir`. With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) `dir` must resolve inside it (a relative `dir` is relative to the root, not to the store's directory): 403 otherwise.

POST /api/store/attic/restore.description: Replays an attic entry onto the live graph.

POST /api/store/backup.description: A verified backup into `dir` (default `<store>-backup`; an existing backup takes an increment). With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) `dir` must resolve inside it (a relative `dir` is relative to the root, not to the store's directory): 403 otherwise.

POST /api/store/checkpoint.description: Writes a checkpoint (422 with the diagnostic on failure; 409 without a store).

POST /api/store/compact.description: Prunes and compacts the store; 409 with `marksUnreachable` when a prune would lose marks and `dropMarks` is not true.

POST /api/store/fork.description: Copies the state at `target` into a new store `dir`: `{fork}` (409: the directory exists). With a file root (`ContextBuilder::file_root`, EXPERIMENTAL) `dir` must resolve inside it (a relative `dir` is relative to the root, not to the store's directory): 403 otherwise.

POST /api/store/rollback.description: Rolls the store back to `target` (the undone commits go to the attic unless `delete`).

POST /api/store/view.description: Serves the state at `target` read-only: `{view, graph}`.
